# How I Write Documentation That People Actually Read

Most documentation is ignored. Here's what makes the difference.

## Start with a working example

Show the full command or code snippet first, then explain what it does. Readers scan for the code block before reading prose.

## Version your docs with your code

Docs that live in a separate repo drift out of sync. Colocate docs with the code they describe.

## Measure what's missing

Search logs tell you what users typed before raising a support ticket. Those queries are your documentation backlog.

Write for the reader who is in a hurry and slightly frustrated. They'll thank you for it.
